purpose: Teach: 趣向/営み/勤める/試聴/範疇/本位/比重/集英社

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文発表に趣向を凝らしろ
lines.en: Ren — put more thought and craft into your paper presentation.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Measured pace. Not unkind, but expectant. The tone of someone who sees potential and won't accept less.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者の日々の営みを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused the paper on the daily work of researchers themselves.
lines.style: Careful, measured response. Slight pause before answering—he's thinking as he speaks. Earnest but not defensive. Eager to show he's understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室に長く勤める覚悟を持て
lines.en: Ren — you need to commit to staying in this lab for the long haul.
lines.style: Steady, unadorned. A moment of weight behind it. Not a suggestion, but a necessary thing being said. Eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表前に試聴会で予行練習しました
lines.en: Yes. I did a practice run at a dry run before the conference presentation.
lines.style: Prompt, dutiful response. Shows he's been working. Voice stays level and responsible, no flourish. The tone of someone checking a box but meaning it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自分の研究範疇を明確にしろ
lines.en: Ren — you need to be clear about the scope of your own research.
lines.style: Firm, direct. A tap of emphasis on the core instruction. The voice of someone who has seen researchers lose themselves in unclear territory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者本位の研究室運営を心がけます
lines.en: Yes. I'm making sure to run the lab with the researcher's perspective at the center.
lines.style: Earnest and deliberate. He's still thinking, still committing. Voice steady and sincere—he's internalizing this, not just agreeing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の中で実証データの比重を上げろ
lines.en: Ren — increase the weight of empirical data in your paper.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Precise. A hint of impatience—this is the third or fourth concrete note, building in specificity. Still measured, still fair.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。集英社の雑誌に研究紹介の寄稿予定です
lines.en: Yes. I have a publication lined up in a Shueisha magazine to introduce the research.
lines.style: Prompt, satisfied close. Voice lifting slightly with the concrete proof. Still respectful, but this time there's a note of 'I've already done this' underneath.
